verdict: Plays from the camp to the gate with no error and no stuck spot; every person, pack, door and the ruler work, the ruler in its own model. One slip in the words fixed (the market had two names); the ruler's name left for you.

found.title: The market had two names
found.text: The map, the keeper and the place said “the fish market”, but the main quest's step said “Clear the oyster market” and its waystone was “The oyster market stone”; the step “Light the lighthouse and the signal fire” named a place the map calls “The beacon”. Cause: the floor's maker (src/tower/world/gen/harbour.ts) renamed the places but not the words that name them. Now the steps and the stone follow the new names (only these three strings changed in the baked floor).

found.title: The ruler's name: Captain or Admiral?
found.text: The floor calls its ruler “the Drowned Captain” (keeper's line, the lair, the quest, the boss card); the Codex (climb/rulers.md, climb/sea.md) says the Drowned Admiral rules floors 1 and 2, and floor 2 calls him the Drowned Admiral. Its model is the Admiral's. Renaming floor 1's to “the Drowned Admiral” is five strings in gen/harbour.ts and a re-bake; say if you want it.
pics: Floor 1's ruler: the Admiral's model under the name “The Drowned Captain”
